title: A focused cargo filter can silently miss newly added tests (they compile but don't run), and the run still reads as passing evidence for them
outcome: A focused run offered as evidence for new tests shows which tests actually executed, and a run whose filter selected none of the named new tests can't be reported as passing them.
acceptance: A focused cargo filter can silently miss newly added tests (they compile but don't run), and the run still reads as passing evidence for them is done
